We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Job Summary: Join Bank of America’s Healthcare, Education & Not-for-Profit (HENFP) business—part of the Global Commercial Bank—and play a leading role in expanding our presence in Denver. The Senior Relationship Manager is a high-impact, client-facing role responsible for driving new business, deepening existing relationships, and delivering profitable growth across a portfolio of complex, mission-driven organizations. HENFP is purpose-built for this market: our teams bring specialized coverage and solutions to not-for-profit healthcare (hospitals, health systems, and insurance providers), private higher education, and large nonprofits/NGOs. You’ll partner with a deep bench of product specialists to help clients optimize their financial strategies—from capital and credit solutions to treasury, payments, and broader corporate banking capabilities—while advising senior leaders on topics like industry trends, liquidity, and capital structure. The clients you’ll cover are sophisticated institutions with annual revenues starting at $50MM and no upper limit, including some of the largest organizations in the country. Key responsibilities include serving as the primary point of contact or trusted advisor and acquiring, deepening, and maintaining profitable relationships, collaborating with teammates, and facilitating client relationships with Product Specialists. Job expectations include having knowledge of the bank's products and services in order to identify cross-selling opportunities and increase overall client satisfaction. Responsibilities: Manages an extensive portfolio of HENFP clients and prospects with annual revenues of $50 million and above to help companies save, borrow, and invest for their current and future needs Acquires, deepens, and maintains profitable client relationships through sales, prospecting, and enhancing existing relationships Understands and interprets financial and cash flow statements to assess and analyze financial conditions of companies and industry trends Collaborates with domestic and international teammates throughout the bank, including Investment Banking, Foreign Exchange, and Wealth Management and facilitates client relationships with Product Specialists in Credit, Treasury Management, and Merchant Services in order to design and deliver financial solutions to clients and prospects Leads and facilitates dialogue with a variety of complex clients and prospects regarding topics such as the client and prospect industry, alternative capital structures, and general business issues Coaches and mentors peers, while utilizing leadership skills Adapts to changes in sales practices and broader market and industry conditions as needed Skills: Client Management Client Solutions Advisory Prospecting Relationship Building Risk Management Financial Analysis Leadership Development Project Management Referral Identification Sales Performance Management Business Development Client Experience Branding Continuous Improvement Data and Trend Analysis Pipeline Management Required Qualifications: 10+ years’ experience in broad based commercial lending/corporate finance/relationship management experience Demonstrates management capability of an extensive portfolio of Healthcare, Education and NFP clients with revenues greater than $50 million. Proven track record of prospecting new business, enhancing existing relationships and closing profitable transactions. Professional proven sales skills and experience, including planning, execution and follow up of client meetings. Strong corporate finance, capital markets and accounting acumen. Financial modeling experience and the completion of a formal credit training preferred. Outstanding oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated leadership ability. Capable of organizing, facilitating, leading and negotiating with a team of bank associates to solve client problems. Securities Industry Essentials (SIE), Series 7 & 63 (Must obtain SIE, series 7 & 63 license within 180 days of start date) Desired Skills: Undergraduate degree in related field or equivalent work experience. MBA desirable. Existing knowledge of the market preferred. Active member/participation in local community organizations. Highly desirable to have active networking contacts and Centers of Influence established in market. Desire to work in a specialty team with an interest in Healthcare, Education & NFP institutions. review_candidates.description: Job Description Position: Site Project Manager Reporting To: Managing Director Location: Naxal, Kathmandu Job Purpose: The Site Project Manager will lead and oversee all civil and structural aspects of hydropower construction projects. The role acts as a technical and coordination bridge between Developer and the Construction Company (EPC/Contractor), ensuring that project design intent, quality standards, safety, timelines and contractual requirements are properly implemented at site. The position ensures smooth coordination, minimizes technical conflicts and safeguards the developer’s interests during construction. Key Duties and Responsibilities: 1. Technical Oversight Review and verify civil engineering designs, drawings, BOQs, and technical specifications prepared by consultants and the construction company. Ensure construction works comply with approved designs, technical standards and contractual requirements. Provide technical input during design finalization and value engineering without compromising safety and quality. Review construction methodologies, work plans and schedules proposed by the contractor. 2. Developer–Contractor Coordination (Bridge Role) Act as the primary technical interface between Aspire Power and the construction company. Translate developer requirements into practical construction execution plans. Coordinate regular technical meetings between developer, consultants, and contractor. Resolve technical disagreements and interpretation gaps between design intent and site execution. Support contract administration from the technical side (variation orders, claims, clarifications, approvals). 3. Site Supervision & Quality Control Conduct regular site inspections to monitor construction progress, quality, safety and compliance. Ensure quality control procedures, material approvals and workmanship standards are followed. Identify construction defects, deviations, and risks and ensure timely corrective actions. Approve work stages, measurements and technical certifications before payment recommendations. 4. Construction Planning & Progress Monitoring Review and monitor construction schedules and milestones. Track progress against project timelines and report delays, risks, and bottlenecks to management. Coordinate with project managers and contractors to ensure timely mobilization of manpower, equipment and materials. Support preparation and review of monthly progress reports for the developer. 5. Safety, Environment & Compliance Ensure that construction works follow safety regulations, environmental requirements, and project-specific HSE standards. Support compliance with environmental approvals (IEE/EIA conditions) and safeguard measures. Coordinate with safety officers and consultants to minimize site risks and accidents. Report major safety and environmental concerns to senior management. 6. Documentation & Reporting Maintain technical records of construction progress, site instructions, non-conformance reports and approvals. Review and certify contractor submissions, method statements, shop drawings and as-built drawings. Prepare technical reports for management, lenders and stakeholders when required. Support audits, inspections, and technical reviews by third parties and government agencies. 7. Risk Management & Problem Solving Identify technical, geotechnical and construction risks early and recommend mitigation measures. Provide on-site problem-solving support during unforeseen ground conditions, design conflicts or execution challenges. Support dispute avoidance and resolution through proper documentation and technical justification. Ensure that developer interests (cost, quality, time, long-term asset durability) are protected. Qualifications: Bachelor in Civil Engineering, Master’s Degree in Civil Engineering will be preferred Specialized training in hydropower, tunneling, geotechnical engineering, or structural engineering is a plus Experience: Minimum 5–6 years of professional experience in civil construction works Proven experience in hydropower construction projects (headworks, tunnel, powerhouse, penstock supports, access roads, bridges, etc.) Prior experience working with or within construction companies (EPC/contractors) Experience representing developer/owner side in large infrastructure projects is highly preferred Key Skills & Competencies: Strong understanding of hydropower civil structures and construction methods Ability to coordinate between developer and contractor teams Contract interpretation and technical claims review skills Strong leadership and communication skills Problem-solving and decision-making ability Ability to work under pressure at remote project sites Strong reporting and documentation skills Interested and eligible candidates are requested to send their updated CV to Email Address: nepalhydro71@gmail.com

review_candidates.title: Senior Legal Hold Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Legal Hold Specialist Location: UAE (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Level: Senior Work Arrangement: Fully Remote — 100% Work From Home About Us We are committed to maintaining strong legal compliance, defensible information governance, and effective preservation of business records. We are seeking an experienced Senior Legal Hold Specialist to manage legal hold processes, coordinate the preservation of potentially relevant information, and support legal, compliance, and investigation teams in meeting their document retention and preservation obligations. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of legal hold administration, electronic discovery (eDiscovery), records management, and data preservation practices, together with exceptional attention to detail, confidentiality, and stakeholder coordination skills. Key Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end legal hold process, from initial notification and custodian identification through acknowledgment, monitoring, modification, and release. Coordinate with legal counsel, compliance teams, human resources, IT, information security, and business stakeholders to implement preservation requirements. Review legal requests, litigation notices, regulatory inquiries, internal investigations, and other matters requiring the preservation of potentially relevant information. Identify relevant custodians, systems, repositories, devices, communication platforms, and business records that may fall within the scope of a legal hold. Prepare and distribute legal hold notices with clear preservation instructions, deadlines, and acknowledgment requirements. Monitor custodian acknowledgments and follow up on outstanding responses, overdue confirmations, and preservation-related actions. Coordinate with IT and records management teams to suspend routine deletion, overwriting, or destruction of relevant information where required and authorized. Support the preservation of emails, documents, messaging records, collaboration platform content, databases, and other electronically stored information. Maintain accurate legal hold registers, matter records, custodian lists, preservation logs, and supporting documentation. Review legal hold scopes periodically and coordinate updates when matters expand, change, or require additional custodians or data sources. Support the release of legal holds following documented authorization from the appropriate legal authority. Ensure that legal hold releases are communicated clearly and that any remaining retention obligations are considered before normal records management processes resume. Coordinate with eDiscovery and legal technology teams on data preservation, collection, processing, and transfer activities. Assist with identifying preservation gaps, potential data loss risks, and non-compliance with legal hold instructions. Escalate preservation failures, missing acknowledgments, unauthorized deletion, and other material issues to the appropriate legal and compliance stakeholders. Support internal investigations, regulatory examinations, litigation readiness activities, and audit requests involving preserved information. Maintain evidence of legal hold notifications, acknowledgments, reminders, scope changes, preservation actions, and release approvals. Help develop and maintain legal hold policies, standard operating procedures, templates, training materials, and workflow documentation. Monitor legal hold compliance metrics and prepare reports on active matters, custodian responses, overdue actions, and preservation status. Support periodic reviews of legal hold procedures to improve consistency, efficiency, defensibility, and recordkeeping quality. Promote awareness of preservation obligations among employees and relevant stakeholders through guidance and training. Protect confidential, privileged, personal, and sensitive information in accordance with applicable legal, privacy, and information security requirements. Perform all responsibilities remotely while maintaining secure access to legal documentation and effective coordination across distributed teams. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Information Governance, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related field. At least 5–8 years of relevant experience in legal hold administration, eDiscovery, litigation support, records management, legal operations, or information governance. Demonstrated experience administering legal hold notices, custodian acknowledgments, preservation tracking, and hold release procedures. Strong understanding of electronically stored information (ESI), document preservation, retention schedules, and defensible information management practices. Familiarity with litigation support workflows, regulatory investigations, internal investigations, and legal discovery processes. Experience coordinating with legal counsel, IT teams, compliance personnel, records managers, and business stakeholders. Knowledge of email systems, collaboration platforms, enterprise document repositories, and other common sources of potentially relevant information. Familiarity with eDiscovery platforms, legal hold management systems, and electronic document management tools. Understanding of data privacy, confidentiality, access controls, and the handling of legally privileged or sensitive information. Ability to interpret legal preservation instructions and translate them into clear, actionable operational requirements. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple legal matters, custodian groups, and deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written communication skills, particularly in preparing notices, instructions, reminders, and status reports. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and issue-escalation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and familiarity with legal matter tracking or workflow management systems. Familiarity with UAE legal, regulatory, and data protection requirements relevant to information preservation is an advantage. High professional integrity, discretion, and attention to detail when handling confidential information. Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Relevant certifications in eDiscovery, information governance, records management, or legal operations are an advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Legal Hold Compliance: Maintain effective implementation and monitoring of legal holds across applicable matters. Notification Timeliness: Issue legal hold notices within established internal deadlines. Acknowledgment Rate: Achieve timely acknowledgment of legal hold notices by relevant custodians. Preservation Effectiveness: Reduce the risk of inadvertent deletion, loss, or alteration of potentially relevant information. Documentation Accuracy: Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable legal hold records. Issue Resolution: Escalate and coordinate resolution of preservation gaps and compliance issues promptly. Scope Management: Ensure legal holds are updated, reviewed, and released only with appropriate authorization. Stakeholder Coordination: Maintain effective collaboration among legal, IT, compliance, and business teams. Reporting Quality: Deliver timely and accurate reports on active holds, outstanding acknowledgments, and preservation status. Process Efficiency: Improve legal hold workflows, tracking procedures, and administrative turnaround times. Confidentiality and Security: Maintain appropriate protection of privileged, sensitive, and personal information. Continuous Improvement: Recommend enhancements to legal hold procedures, training, systems, and governance controls. What We Offer Competitive compensation based on qualifications and professional experience. 100% remote work arrangement , allowing you to work from home without routine office attendance. Opportunities to contribute to legal operations, information governance, litigation readiness, and regulatory compliance. A collaborative environment focused on accountability, confidentiality, and operational excellence. Opportunities for professional development in legal technology, eDiscovery, and information governance. Access to digital collaboration platforms and secure systems that support remote work. A performance-oriented culture that values accuracy, integrity, sound judgment, and continuous improvement. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated CV and a brief cover letter highlighting their legal hold administration experience, knowledge of electronic information preservation, eDiscovery expertise, and achievements in legal compliance or information governance. Email Subject Line: Application – Senior Legal Hold Specialist (Fully Remote, UAE) We welcome experienced professionals who combine strong information governance knowledge, meticulous documentation practices, sound judgment, and a commitment to defensible legal preservation processes. Important: This position is intended to be fully remote. Candidates should confirm applicable employment, residency, and work authorization requirements before accepting an offer.

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story' Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world. We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world. An HDR Senior ITS Engineer provides project and task leadership in planning, designing, and implementing technology solutions for transportation challenges. This role is part of HDR’s Advanced Technology for Surface Transportation (ATST) business class, which primarily serves government agencies. This position will also be responsible for building and maintaining client relationships and helping clients identify and implement innovative transportation technology solutions. This role offers the opportunity to help shape and grow HDR’s transportation technology, digital infrastructure, and intelligent transportation systems services in Missouri, Kansas, and nationally. Technical Related Responsibilities Lead planning, design, integration, deployment, and operations of ITS and transportation technology systems including communications networks, ATMS/TMC systems, field devices, corridor technology solutions, traffic signal systems, and roadway lighting. Lead and support development and implementation of TSMO, connected vehicle, digital infrastructure, and emerging mobility initiatives for state and local agencies. Lead the preparation of PS&E packages, systems engineering documentation, ITS architectures, and technical analyses for transportation technology projects. Serve as a technical resource and client-facing representative for transportation technology initiatives regionally and nationally. Non-Technical Related Responsibilities Support project delivery activities including scope development, budgeting, scheduling, coordination, and client communication. Establish client relationships and have significant roles in marketing, contractual, design, and production activities Coordinate project staffing and workloads with business class leadership Implement QA/QC procedures Assist with the development of Federal USDOT Grant applications for government agencies Preferred Qualifications MSCE Diverse Experience in related fields such as toll roads, roadway design, or construction Interest in client development, mentoring, and growing transportation technology services Experience working with state DOTs, local agencies, Federal government Active role in professional organizations Familiarity with Traffic Engineering concepts like signal timing, ATSPMs, adaptive traffic control systems, priority systems, and traffic-responsive systems Understanding of fiber optic networks Excellent written and verbal communication skills Interest in or progress toward Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) certification Interest in data analytics Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree A minimum of 10 years' experience in ITS and traffic engineering for urban and rural highways, major and minor interchanges and intersections Requires professional engineering license recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered. Example: Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license. Knowledge of regulations of state and federal transportation agencies Proficiency with Microsoft Office Experience using HCS, CORSIM, Synchro/SIM Traffic and other software packages Strong oral and written communication skills, presentation skills and ability to work in a team environment An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must What We Believe HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve. Our Commitment As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day. Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees. We are an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer (https://www.hdrinc.com/equal-employment-opportunity-employer). review_candidates.description: Building a sustainable tomorrow We are currently looking for experienced Senior Estimators to join our established Social Infrastructure, Nuclear and Defence pre-construction team. This business unit covers a diverse portfolio including regional civil engineering projects, flood defence schemes, water and wastewater frameworks, near-shore marine works, and nuclear and defence infrastructure. As we continue to secure new opportunities across these sectors, this recruitment represents an exciting opportunity to strengthen our capabilities and build on the knowledge and experience within the team. No two opportunities are the same. From early-stage budget pricing and Early Contractor Involvement (ECI) contracts through to complex competitive tenders and major infrastructure projects, you will have the opportunity to influence projects throughout their development lifecycle and play a key role in shaping winning solutions. You will join an experienced pre-construction team bringing together estimating, planning, design management, commercial and operational expertise. Working closely with project teams, clients, design partners and supply chain organisations, you will help develop safe, buildable and value-driven solutions for clients across a diverse range of infrastructure opportunities within the Social Infrastructure, Nuclear and Defence sectors. Your team We welcome applications from experienced candidates based anywhere across England and Wales. A BAM office will be nominated as your contractual base, but this role is designed around flexibility rather than regular attendance at a specific location. Your working pattern will be agreed with your line manager, and will include collaboration days, client meetings, project site visits, and a mutually agreed combination of home and office-based working. With access to BAM's network of regional offices and project locations, you will be able to work in a way that supports both your performance and wellbeing. This role is ideally suited to proactive, self-motivated professionals who are comfortable working independently while contributing to a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team. Making Possible As a Senior Estimator, You Will Be Responsible For Coordinating with bid teams, colleagues in estimating, the wider pre-construction team and ECI project teams. Managing and delivering cost estimates at various design and scope stages, including multiple iterations of budget and target prices. Supporting ECI teams with project budget development, value engineering, efficiency proposals and Construction Target Cost preparation. Contributing to optioneering, feasibility studies and multidisciplinary solution development. Liaising with clients, designers, consultants, quantity surveyors and wider third-party stakeholders. Preparing and administering tender documentation, correspondence, supply chain enquiries and quotations. Challenging and supporting bid preparation to develop safe, cost-effective and buildable solutions. Gathering and distributing lessons learned and remaining current with emerging techniques and innovations. Preparing first-principles cost estimates using Candy estimating software. Participating in bid preparation, review sessions and tender settlement meetings. Producing tender summaries, risk and opportunity registers, and communicating estimate details at review and handover stages. Ensuring compliance with BAM and Group bid governance procedures. What do you bring to the role? Degree, HND in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification. Significant experience within civil engineering, infrastructure or major project delivery environments, gained through estimating, commercial, engineering or operational leadership roles. Proven experience leading or managing complex estimates and tender submissions within a civil engineering or infrastructure setting. Experience pricing a variety of civil engineering disciplines, with a strong understanding of construction methods and typical production rates. Demonstrable understanding of common forms of contract, including NEC. Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience guiding teams to achieve challenging deadlines. Desirable - Ability to obtain and maintain Security Check (SC) clearance. Previous experience working in regulated, nuclear or defence environments would be advantageous but is not essential. What’s in it for you? Competitive salary A wide range of family-friendly policies Company car/car allowance/travel allowance 8 % matched pension contributions Private healthcare Life assurance 26 days holiday 2 wellbeing days 1 volunteering day Personal and professional development About BAM Building a sustainable tomorrow. That’s our mission and our promise at BAM. It’s how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe. We strive to create an environment where everybody feels welcome and valued. We’re on an exciting journey to employ the best talent to join us regardless of social background, race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or other characteristics. review_candidates.title: Scientist
review_candidates.company: Jiangsu Surun Talent Development Group Co., Ltd.
review_candidates.description: Global Scientific Talent Recruitment (2027) Join The Overseas Talent Program Advance Your Research. Build Global Collaboration. Create Real-World Impact. Position Title Global Scientific Talent | Overseas Talent Program Tracks: Innovation Talent | Young Talent | Postdoctoral Talent Location Flexible Flexible working and collaboration arrangements may be available, including relocation, joint appointments, part-time engagement, and project-based research collaboration, depending on the selected host institution and program requirements. Employment / Collaboration Types Full-time Part-time Joint Appointment Project-based Collaboration Research Collaboration About the Opportunity We are seeking outstanding international scientists, researchers, engineers, technology experts, and innovators to participate in The 2027 Overseas Talent Program. The program is designed to connect experienced global talent with leading universities, research institutes, laboratories, hospitals, and high-tech enterprises in China , supporting international research collaboration, technological innovation, and long-term academic and industrial development. Depending on your background and career stage, you may be considered for one of three major pathways: Innovation Talent — for established researchers, senior scientists, technical leaders, and experienced industry R&D experts Young Talent — for outstanding early-career researchers with strong academic or technological potential Postdoctoral Talent — for qualified researchers at the early postdoctoral / post-PhD stage The program may provide opportunities to develop research projects, establish joint research teams, participate in major scientific initiatives, collaborate with Chinese institutions, and translate research into practical applications. Research Areas Applications are welcomed across a broad range of science, engineering, medicine, and technology disciplines, including but not limited to: Digital & Emerging Technologies Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Data Science & Computing Information Technology & Digital Science Quantum Science & Quantum Computing Robotics & Intelligent Systems Advanced Engineering & Manufacturing Semiconductor Technologies & Integrated Circuits Advanced Manufacturing Aerospace Engineering Automation & Intelligent Manufacturing Industrial Technology Energy & Sustainability New Energy & Energy Storage Smart Grid & Energy Systems Environmental Sustainability Carbon Neutrality Green Technologies Life Sciences & Healthcare Biotechnology Biomedical Engineering Precision Medicine Gene & Cell Therapy Medical Devices Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Technologies Materials & Nanotechnology Advanced Materials Nanotechnology Materials Science Energy Materials Semiconductor Materials Other emerging and interdisciplinary areas may also be considered. Potential Host Institutions Depending on your research profile, expertise, and project direction, candidates may be matched with suitable organizations, including: Leading universities Research institutes Key laboratories Chinese Academy of Sciences institutes Hospitals and medical research centers State-owned enterprises High-tech companies Listed technology companies Innovation centers and R&D platforms The final host institution and collaboration model will depend on your qualifications, research interests, project direction, and institutional requirements. Why Join the Program? 1. International Research Collaboration Collaborate with established research teams and institutions in China while maintaining your international academic or professional network. 2. Access to Research Resources Potential access to: Advanced research facilities Major scientific and technology projects Research funding opportunities Multidisciplinary research teams Industry-academia collaboration platforms Technology commercialization opportunities 3. Flexible Collaboration Models Relocation to China is not necessarily required at the initial stage . Depending on the selected program pathway and host institution, opportunities may include: Full-time positions in China Joint appointments Part-time academic or technical roles Remote or project-based collaboration Visiting research positions Short-term research visits International joint research projects The specific arrangement will be discussed and confirmed with the relevant host institution. 4. Competitive Compensation & Government Support Depending on the candidate's qualifications, program track, host institution, and local policies, eligible candidates may receive competitive compensation and government-supported talent benefits. Indicative annual salary range: Approximately USD 70,000 – USD 285,000+ Potential government talent awards may include: Innovation Talent Talent Award: up to approximately USD 570,000 Housing Support: up to approximately USD 240,000 Young Talent Talent Award: up to approximately USD 430,000 Housing Support: up to approximately USD 240,000 Postdoctoral Talent Talent Award: up to approximately USD 285,000 Housing Support: up to approximately USD 240,000 Outstanding candidates may also be eligible for additional research funding of up to approximately USD 715,000 , depending on the applicable program and host institution. Please note: Compensation, awards, housing support, research funding, and other benefits are subject to eligibility, government policies, host institution arrangements, and final program approval. The figures above are indicative rather than guaranteed. Who Should Apply? We welcome applications from international professionals with strong academic, research, engineering, or technology backgrounds, including: Professors Associate Professors Assistant Professors Principal Investigators Senior Scientists Research Scientists Research Fellows Postdoctoral Researchers R&D Directors Industry R&D Experts Engineering Leaders Technology Innovators Technical Specialists Candidates from the following organizations are particularly encouraged to apply: Universities Research institutes Hospitals Multinational corporations Technology companies Pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies Semiconductor companies Advanced manufacturing companies Energy and materials companies Other R&D-focused organizations General Eligibility Candidates are generally expected to demonstrate: A PhD or equivalent advanced research qualification, where applicable Strong research, technical, or industrial experience A track record of research, innovation, technology development, or R&D leadership Relevant publications, patents, projects, products, or other professional achievements The ability to develop or contribute to a meaningful research or innovation project in collaboration with a Chinese host institution Specific eligibility requirements vary between program tracks and may also depend on the candidate's field, career stage, and proposed host institution.

review_candidates.title: Sales Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Ecommerce With Ramzan is a growing e-commerce business focused on building strong online brands and delivering reliable digital retail solutions. The company emphasizes data-driven decision making, streamlined operations, and customer-centric strategies to drive sustainable sales growth. Team members are encouraged to learn, experiment, and adapt to evolving market trends in a supportive environment. The organization values accountability, performance, and collaboration, offering opportunities for professional development in modern e-commerce practices. Role Description The Sales Manager role at Ecommerce With Ramzan is a full-time, on-site position based in Faisalabad. The Sales Manager will oversee daily sales operations, including managing a sales team, setting targets, monitoring performance, and ensuring effective execution of sales strategies. This role involves analyzing sales data, identifying growth opportunities, and coordinating with marketing and operations to optimize product listings, pricing, and promotions. The Sales Manager will maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, handle escalated customer issues related to sales, and contribute to forecasting and planning. Regular responsibilities include reporting on sales results, guiding team members through coaching and training, and implementing best practices to increase revenue and market presence. Qualifications Demonstrated experience in sales management, preferably within e-commerce or retail environments. Strong skills in sales planning, target setting, and performance monitoring. Proficiency in using digital tools and platforms for sales tracking, reporting, and analytics. Ability to lead, motivate, and develop a sales team through clear communication and coaching. Solid understanding of customer behavior, online buying journeys, and conversion optimization. Strong negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a professional business context. Ability to work on-site in Faisalabad and collaborate across teams in a fast-paced environment. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field is preferred. Prior experience in developing and implementing sales processes and performance dashboards is an advantage.
